title: Invertibility of the integral dualizing comparison
statement: For l, E, L, ι, X, D, hl, the scheme hypotheses, and dualizing data wE and wL as in [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core], the canonical comparison u l E L ι X D hl wE wL is an isomorphism.

proof.text: At cofinal ramification-multiple exponents the finite-free counit-defined dualizing maps are invertible. Finite dualizing coefficient change and tensor descent give invertibility at every exponent; coherence and normalized DVR effectivity identify the total-limit map with the unique map `u` characterized by its counit reductions.
